function.name: reschedule_tool
function.description: Reschedule a lead's call via API

phoneNumber.description: The time and day the client wants to reschedule the call. Must be in Paris timezone (Europe/Paris) in a format that JavaScript's new Date() can parse (e.g., '2024-01-15T14:30:00+01:00' for Paris time during standard time, '2024-01-15T14:30:00+02:00' for Paris time during daylight saving time).

scheduledCallAt.description: The exact datetime to reschedule the call, in Paris timezone. Should be a value like {{reschedule_date}} formatted as ISO 8601 (e.g., 2024-01-15T14:30:00+01:00 or +02:00 during DST).
